# United Kingdom

Region: Europe. Sources verified 2026-10-11. Scope follows source documentation, not assumed nationwide CAMT availability.

## Country / regional references

### Bank of England

**Role:** Central bank / CHAPS and RTGS operator

**Reporting coverage:** CHAPS/RTGS statements, liquidity reports and notifications

**Messages / versions:** camt.052; camt.053.001.08; camt.054; camt.060; pacs

- [Final CHAPS/RTGS changes forNov2025](https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/-/media/boe/files/payments/rtgs-renewal-programme/iso-20022/chaps-rtgs-iso20022-change-request-nov25-final.pdf) — specification; public-file
- [ISO 20022 Handbook](https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/payment-and-settlement/rtgs-renewal-programme/iso-20022-handbook) — availability; unavailable
- [Schema distribution](https://www2.swift.com/mystandards/) — specification; registration

The public final changes PDF discusses CAMT060 requesting CAMT052 liquidity reports, CAMT053.001.08, and CAMT054 proprietary transaction codes. Detailed schemas and guidance are on MyStandards. The handbook search index mentions CAMT060.001.05, but the direct handbook URL returned 404; the live PDF supports reporting scope.

### Pay.UK Standards Authority

**Role:** Retail payment-system operator and standards body

**Reporting coverage:** Payment conversion / retail ISO 20022 standards; no CAMT052/053 customer-statement profile established

**Messages / versions:** pacs.008; pacs.002; pacs.004; ISO8583-to-ISO20022 mapping

- [FPS ISO 20022 standards library](https://www.wearepay.uk/what-we-do/payment-systems/faster-payment-system/faster-payment-system-iso20022-standards-library/) — availability; public-page
- [Standards Authority](https://www.wearepay.uk/what-we-do/standards-authority/) — availability; public-page

The library provides recommended ISO 8583 and ISO 20022 conversion in PDF and interactive HTML. It does not establish universal CAMT statement output from FPS or Bacs corporate files. Authority scope also includes Confirmation of Payee and Request to Pay.
